source_role: Build Tool persisted/exportable selection contract (initial draft)

owns: Builder profile identity and user selection
Separation of desired composition from emitted code and target runtime configuration

confirmed.rule: Build Profiles must be saveable and exportable.
Build Profiles belong to the optional AIGMos System View BUILD and associated CS functions, not a new Hardcore layer.
A Profile defines selected target, modules, features and optional interfaces, not a precomputed direct/transitive dependency truth.
Profile operations must not provide CS/FILE path access to protected runtime /config.
Builder uses a complete coherent full-system source checkout/snapshot as dependency universe for pruning; no independent version solving for each dependency.

source.snapshot_id: <source snapshot reference; may be Git commit, hash, or local pinned snapshot>

field_semantics.source.snapshot_id: Source inventory pin for tracing/reproducing builds; optional within interactive editing if builder has an active inventory, but resolved before final build.
field_semantics.selection.target: MP or CP build target, NOT source-header BOTH. Build profile selects one concrete output target.
field_semantics.selection.modules: Identifiers chosen from Source Registry/StructureTree; default and required closure computed, not persisted as authoritative graph.
field_semantics.selection.features: Optional feature IDs such as AC/IAM; target-specific AC.MP/AC.CP variants are NOT standalone profile features.
field_semantics.selection.expose: Chosen optional external transport/bindings to compile into build, not runtime service secrets.
field_semantics.options.strip_unselected: Actually remove unnecessary source code and its exclusive transitive dependencies.

operations.names: Exact CS command namespace and parameters OPEN; do not treat these labels as canonical CS commands

persistence.owner: Builder-specific FILE-backed user data outside protected /config
export_rules: Export only profile/selection metadata and non-secret provenance
Never export access tokens/API keys, runtime private configuration or arbitrary FILE paths
Preserve unknown-but-valid profiles in inspect mode; fail build when required module/capability missing
Imported profiles need schema, ID, target and feature validation

resolution: Profile + one pinned full-source snapshot -> validated selected components -> derived dependency closure -> physically pruned target artifact. Do not store computed closure as a second semantic authority.
open_decisions: Final portable schema, stable naming conventions and profile revisions
Source pin/reference portability between machines and offline imports
Hardware selector and target constraints schema
Exact CS operation names, profile FILE storage locations and import permissions
Default profile migration on source inventory change
How to version the profile schema independently from the repository snapshot

compatibility.header: Current 1.9 header v0.2.0 only has MP/CP and defines MP as both; next CodeMarkup/header version introduces BOTH without silently rewriting historical meaning.
